station.Abyss2199.desc: A mining complex built into one of Europa’s deep fissures. Here, corporations extract rare elements formed directly in the ice due to high pressure. The miners who survive here are valued at all mining sites in the Solar System.
station.Abyss2199.name: Abyss-2199
station.Akatsuki.desc: On Earth, there is almost no production. That is, at least, according to reports distributed through the SBN. Factories have been moved into orbit to preserve the fragile ecology of humanity's cradle. Akatsuki Kojou is a very old-fashioned orbital factory that operates on atomic energy.
station.Akatsuki.name: Akatsuki Kojou
station.AliJinnah.desc: The station is located in a deep volcanic canyon. The main warehouse of heat-resistant drones is located here. They monitor the activity of the volcanoes and pave the way to new deposits. The bridges and platforms suspended under the arches of the canyon resemble giant honeycombs made of black steel.
station.AliJinnah.name: Ali Jinnah
station.AllianceArcology.desc: The third-largest building on the Moon. Alliance Arcology is a city within a city. It has business levels, residential levels and even production levels. The daily income from owning Alliance Arcology is difficult to estimate.
station.AllianceArcology.name: Alliance Arcology
station.AnCapDogma.desc: The Moon is a convenient launchpad for flights into the Outer System. The AnCap Dogma Harbor is a large refueling and repair orbital port. Stopping here can help avoid the need to lose time in orbit around Mars on the way to the Asteroid Belt and beyond.
station.AnCapDogma.name: AnCap Dogma
station.Angel.desc: Ceres' main refueling terminal. Fuel for cubecentric engines this far from the Sun costs a huge amount of dignitas. Any transportation conglomerate would be delighted to acquire the Angel terminal.
station.Angel.name: Angel Terminal
station.ArcadisTerminal.desc: Arcadis Transit Terminal is an orbital port for refueling, charging and servicing interplanetary spacecraft. It is a highly profitable enterprise known as Earth's main port in the System.
station.ArcadisTerminal.name: Arcadis
station.AresPost.desc: The High Ares Post was founded by the military of one of the old states as a radar station. After the Great Anarchist Revolution, it was taken over by a corporation. The post, which has grown noticeably since then, is constantly changing hands.
station.AresPost.name: High Ares Post
station.Argyre.desc: The Argyre-14 Mining Station is a colony with extremely challenging working conditions. That's how honest competitive struggle goes. If you're not ready to invent or organize, if you lack the sacred flame of Atlas—you’ll end up selling your labor. And that's okay. Become a worker and take up your worthy place in a free, anarchic society. The station is located right in the middle of the desert. Life here resembles life in boom towns during the colonization of North America's Wild West.
station.Argyre.name: Argyre-14
station.AriciaTholus.desc: A hill, completely excavated by several mining corporations, in the place of which a colossal geodesic dome was erected. When it reflects the light of the Sun, it resembles an eye on the gray and dull face of Vesta. Under the dome is a mining colony and a crater that is being dug ever deeper into the surface of Vesta.
station.AriciaTholus.name: Aricia Tholus
station.Ark.desc: A kind of arcological city on floating platforms. Here corporations build expensive housing for the elite. If offers panoramic views of stormy Jupiter plus full service. According to rumors, the beautiful façade conceals secret laboratories where experiments are carried out on human consciousness.
station.Ark.name: Ark
station.AvicennasClinic.desc: A multidisciplinary medical center. In addition, there is a research unit here.
station.AvicennasClinic.name: Avicenna Clinic
station.Aynrand.desc: A refuge city for wealthy refugees, intellectuals and radical anarchists who could not find a place for themselves even in the AnCap system. The station is located in rolling hills and looks more like an idyllic rural community than a typical corporate town. The owners try not to interfere in the affairs of the commune, preferring to limit themselves to collecting income. However, sometimes ideological differences develop into open conflicts. It is believed that some former executives and engineers are in hiding at Aynrand; they are in possession of secret information, and corporate security services may come in search of it at any time.
station.Aynrand.name: Aynrand
station.Bethlehem.desc: A colony on the surface of Pallas, founded by the now-defunct Hive Corporation. It is an old town by Main Belt standards, having experienced both flourishing and decline. The Pallas resources around the colony were depleted, and it was converted into a local transportation hub.
station.Bethlehem.name: Bethlehem
station.BillGregor.desc: A large chemical complex located near the dunes of solid hydrocarbons. Here, raw materials are processed into components for fuel and synthetic materials. Work shifts follow one after another in conditions of perpetual darkness and piercing winds.
station.BillGregor.name: Bill Gregor
station.BiosphereEU.desc: An sub-ice laboratory complex where they breed GMO fish and algae, trying to develop species that are resistant to extreme cold. There are rumors that sometimes not only scientists make their way under the ice, but also members of secret organizations, who for some reason are strongly attracted to the icy abyss of Europa.
station.BiosphereEU.name: Biosphere EU
station.Blade.desc: This is a flexible space, fitted out to accommodate security personnel. There are gyms, lecture rooms and a living area. The corporation that owns the Blade has a reserve of fresh and motivated security specialists at its disposal. The training ground is named in honor of the Eclipse Blades PMC. They defended themselves from the contractors of an unknown corporation that wanted to stop the HAVOC project.
station.Blade.name: Blade at the Ready
station.BlueMoon.desc: A small orbital station. Serves as a passenger port for those departing from Ceres and arriving here. Luxurious casinos for those waiting for interplanetary spacecraft sit side by side with the dens and hiding places of terrorists, pirates and smugglers, hidden in service tunnels.
station.BlueMoon.name: Blue Moon
station.Boethius.desc: The streams of information circulating in the Solar System are storms of exabytes, passing by the planets. Network centers for processing and routing data are located everywhere. Boethius is one such center. The station facilitates data exchange in the central part of the Inner System.
station.Boethius.name: Boethius
station.bramfaturian_Cattaram.desc: Cattaram is a bottomless labyrinth of dust and crystal, where the light itself is dead. Here rule the Tanaraks — barons of stone who offer their gavvakh to their lord Morax, enthroned upon silicon. Cattaram has absorbed the suffering of the mines and learned to turn it into strength. The silence of its depths is not peace, but the distilled pressure of eternity.
station.bramfaturian_Duggur.desc: The bramfatura of the Moon is a cold ocean of mists and warped fortresses, where sweetness and pain are made equal. Here reigns the Great Harlot Fokerma, trading gavvakh for passion and repentance. Her nearness to Earth nourishes her with the suffering of humankind, and she waits patiently for a new sign — the key to the mystery of Gagtungr.
station.bramfaturian_Flauros.desc: The bramfatura of Jupiter is an eternal nocturnal forest, pulsing with the rhythm of storms and thunder. Here, clans of spirits gather beneath roaring hurricanes to renew their ancient oaths. Above all reigns the horned king Paimon, keeper of thunderbound loyalty to the Solar Empire. Flauros does not contend for power — it simply waits for its master’s return. Its breath lingers in stones and in Earth’s nocturnal hunts, where Jupiter’s echo resounds in the chest like the call of a primordial order.
station.bramfaturian_Gannix.desc: The bramfatura of Venus is an endless temple complex, encircled by an even greater infinity of forest. The air grows heavy with the living breath of green. Here reign the taltnoms — once spirits of freedom, now loyal servants of their long-returned master. Their lord, Tezctlan, is forging the Emerald Empire, binding the spiritual and the material through ritual obelisks.
station.bramfaturian_Olirna_Awakened.des: The bramfatura of Saturn is a realm of radiant mountains, where every breath is a vow of fidelity. Here, spirits serve freedom rather than a master, and their battles are rituals that leave prayers upon the snow. Olirna is governed by the Council of the Great Initiates. This world teaches one truth: the path never ends.
station.bramfaturian_Ron.desc: Ron is the bramfatura of the quasimorphic primordial substance — a viscous ocean of meta-meta-matter from which all other worlds are woven. Here rules Duke Bathin, a languid sovereign in the absence of the vanished king. Ron hums with endless clashes of spirits born from quasimorphic mire. Now it feeds on human gavvakh, and every echo in its dark waters repeats the same word of its lord: “bring more.”
station.bramfaturian_Scrivnus.desc: The bramfatura of Skrivnus is a dead prison of spirits, steeped in the scent of lead, dust, and the memory of violence. Once the forge of the Solar Empire, it now endures under the weight of its own walls. The Gremmugrats and Tarkaors, long since forgetting the meaning of freedom, endlessly forge weapons for a ruler who does not exist. Skrivnus whispers a single revelation — one befitting the personal prison of Gagtungr: even if the lord of the Solar Empire never existed, he must still appear, for the prison waits for its master.
station.bramfaturian_Shartamakhum.desc: The bramfatura of Mercury is a blinding realm of sand and heat, where sunlight itself bears weight. In this merciless desert, the fiery knights known as Farises wage endless wars, turning one another into thralls — Abds — and servants — Malāks. Humanity has brought them a new source of gavvakh, making their wars truly brutal. Above it all reigns the silent Fukabirna, an ocean of molten infra-iron to which the sultans offer their harvested pain.
station.bramfaturian_Ur_Awakened.desc: The bramfatura of Mars is a realm of red dust, ziggurats, and winds that carve the land like cuneiform upon clay. Here reigns the lugal Urparp — once a rebellious emperor, now a zealous servant of the Red and Gold Throne. His army, the Shedu's Thousand, forged from war-possessed humans and spirits alike, seeks battle in the material world. The law of Ur declares: there is no mercy, no cowardice — only judgment, and its execution.
station.Budapest.desc: A ground transportation maintenance and repair station. Due to the high albedo of 434 Hungaria, mapping and orbital surveillance of the asteroid are difficult. For this reason, everyone is forced to use ground transportation here. And as usual, it requires both maintenance and repair.
station.Budapest.name: Budapest
station.CalorisPlanitia.desc: The terraforming of Mercury is still ongoing. Experts say that it will never be possible to create completely hospitable conditions here. For this reason, many colonies operate in automatic mode. This is very convenient for extraction stations. However, there are often residential zones here, in case personnel are needed for repairs or to protect private property.
station.CalorisPlanitia.name: Caloris Planitia
station.Campbell.desc: This is a laboratory for the research of ultrahigh temperatures. An extremely profitable asset and one of the richest sources of industrial innovation in the System.
station.Campbell.name: Norman R. Campbell
station.Canaan.desc: Canaan Terminal is a station for servicing, charging and repairing ground equipment. From here it’s extremely convenient to get to remote and inaccessible places on Phobos. Apart from these obvious features, the base is extremely convenient if you need a secluded place away from the main routes but still functional and with trained staff.
station.Canaan.name: Canaan Terminal
station.Candle.desc: The second-largest building on the Moon. Candle Arcology is a glossy black building resembling a candle. When the Sun rises above New Seattle, bright the center’s exterior sparkles and glows. The building is intended to symbolize the wealth and professionalism of the RealWare corporation.
station.Candle.name: Candle Building
station.Carcosa.desc: A colony spread across a yellow plateau — the station’s name comes inspired by the color of the terrain. Beneath Carcosa’s domes lie residential quarters and research laboratories. The atmospheric haze here is especially dense, creating the illusion of perpetual twilight. It is within Carcosa that the main temple of the <color=#FFFEC1>Church of Revelation</color> is located.
station.Carcosa.name: Carcosa
station.Carmel.desc: The central mining station of Vesta. The first settlers landed at a hill called Mount Carmel. For many years there was an independent religious community here, but during the <color=#FFFEC1>Great Anarchist Revolution</color> (<color=#FFFEC1>GAR</color>) a settlement was found, and all the inhabitants of the community were hired by the CoreWard MG corporation.
station.Carmel.name: Carmel
station.CassinisShadow.desc: A relay and navigation center on a highly elliptical orbit. It manages landing corridors to the surface and monitors atmospheric changes. The station’s hangar includes barracks for housing a small military garrison, making it a key asset for maintaining control over all of <color=#FFFEC1>Titan</color>.
station.CassinisShadow.name: Cassini's Shadow
station.CathodeRampart.desc: An atmospheric production station where the selection and primary processing of hydrogen, helium and rare isotopes takes place. Corporations compete for this place—after all, control of the Bastion provides almost unlimited access to resources for energy-intensive projects in the Outer System.
station.CathodeRampart.name: Cathode Bastion
station.CenterDefense.desc: The CoDT, or Center of Defense Technologies, is a large specialized factory, a rarity in the System. Typically, factories can be easily reconfigured to manufacture any product. However, the CoDT has just one goal: to produce as many weapons as possible. For defensive purposes, of course.
station.CenterDefense.name: CoDT
station.Chancellor.desc: An sub-ice base that was once built as a research center, but after a series of mysterious incidents the project was frozen and turned into a residential colony. According to public archives, the base has been abandoned, but sensors occasionally record activity underneath it. Some researchers suggest that it was this activity that caused the station to be founded here.
station.Chancellor.name: Chancellor
station.Charon.desc: Charon DocBay is a refueling and repair spaceport in the orbit of Phobos. It’s a place where a pub occupies about half of the useful area of a residential module. Tired and experienced workers from the Outer System spend their time here.
station.Charon.name: Charon DocBay
station.ChickMoo.desc: A vast automated factory for the production of synthetic food proteins and the cultivation of plant food. Everything that grows here—from cockroaches to artificial cow livers—is used as food for the inhabitants of the System. Without Chick-Chick/Moo-Moo, extraterrestrial colonies would starve to death.
station.ChickMoo.name: Chick-Chick/Moo-Moo
station.Chimera9.desc: An orbital processing plant. Here, shuttles from the surface of <color=#FFFEC1>Titan</color> transfer their cargoes to interplanetary spacecrafts. Inside the station are vast reservoirs of <color=#FFFEC1>quantum liquid G-3</color>, which the station’s owners distribute and sell at prices set entirely at their own discretion.
station.Chimera9.name: Chimera-9
station.Clotho.desc: Clotho-Node is a transit base under a geodesic dome. It was used by its former owner, Fresco, to access hard-to-reach places in the jungles. For reasons unknown, it is now in complete ruins.
station.Clotho.name: Clotho-Node
station.Connelly.desc: The largest city of the countless settlements on the surface of Hygeia. The population of Connelly-4 is somewhat lower than all the colony buildings can actually accommodate, but it is easy to breathe here. If you have a reliable enough spacesuit or the pressurization system has not failed again. Dusty empty hotels, closed entertainment centers and local branches of corporate exchanges where managers who have misbehaved elsewhere languish in boredom—this is what awaits random travelers in Connelly-4.
station.Connelly.name: Connelly-4
station.Cronus.desc: A navigation hub in high orbit over <color=#FFFEC1>Hyperion</color>. The station synchronizes signals and adjusts the course of spacecrafts passing by the chaotically rotating moon. Its memory stores a vast archive of anomalous readings from the <color=#FFFEC1>even further Outer System</color>. Local research staff refer to this collection as the "Hyperion Chronicles".
station.Cronus.name: Cronus
station.Cryptoria.desc: Cryptoria is a masterpiece of scientific thought built by Dilthey and its contractor, who wished to remain anonymous. It is a unique data center that operates using a complex cooling system based on a closed cycle of liquids and gases. There are never any overheating incidents that result in the suspension of computer operation. Except in cases involving fierce firefights and the use of flamethrowers.
station.Cryptoria.name: Cryptoria
station.DantePeak.desc: At the top of one of the dormant volcanoes is a scientific geolaboratory where they study the internal processes of Io—and also conduct secret tests of new types of thermal coatings and protection. The view of the lava plains from here is mesmerizing, especially in the light of setting Jupiter.
station.DantePeak.name: Dante's Peak
station.DarkFlora.desc: Hidden away from prying eyes are a sociological laboratory and a small educational center. Dark Flora trains spies and corporate agents who need a special moral lability. It is said that the negotiators it produces have two minds, one of which suppresses sincerity. It is this consciousness that seizes control at the critical moment.
station.DarkFlora.name: Dark Flora
station.Deepsky.desc: A closed, heavily guarded base located deep in the mountains of Callisto, far from the railway lines. It is officially listed as abandoned, but rumors about secret operations are constantly circulating. Smugglers, mercenaries and even members of the Civil Resistance hide out here, using this place as a transit point. Internal passageways lead to underground tunnels that go deep below the surface.
station.Deepsky.name: Deepsky
station.Discovery.desc: Discovery RC is a research center. It conducts studies of the photosphere and surface changes on Mercury. One of the center’s laboratories is equipped for studying specific phenomena found in the Solar System.
station.Discovery.name: Discovery RC
station.Dubrovskiy.desc: The main mining settlement of 434 Hungaria, Dubrovsky-1 serves as the main base for numerous drilling posts across the surface of Hungaria. But the asteroid isn't rich in minerals, so there are many abandoned mines scattered around Dubrovsky-1.
station.Dubrovskiy.name: Dubrovsky-1
station.Echo4.desc: A research and habitation complex built within a giant geode beneath <color=#FFFEC1>Phoebe</color>’s surface. In truth, living quarters occupy only a small part of the station — the rest has been converted into hidden hangars for spacecraft repairs and contraband storage. Rumor has it that negotiations take place here among those who prefer to remain in the shadows of the ancap system.
station.Echo4.name: Echo-4
station.Edge.desc: A business center above Venus. There are greenhouses, fancy restaurants and observation decks. The upper class lived a decadent life here until the Tezctlan invasion began.
station.Edge.name: Edge-6
station.EnergyOne.desc: An advanced power plant that extracts energy directly from photons. The Tesla-Musk System installed on it is the intellectual property of the Dilthey Corporation, whose secret is carefully guarded. No one has yet been able to open the system for study, as Dilthey has installed a multi-factor defense system with explosives there.
station.EnergyOne.name: Energy One
station.Eos.desc: The first settlement and base for all miners on Ceres. Here you can pick up information about ore deposits on the asteroid, negotiate exchanges of mined material, hire workers and connect to the markets of the Main Belt and the Inner System.
station.Eos.name: Eos
station.Epitome.desc: The newest colony on the surface of Ceres. A small city equipped with the state-of-the-art engineering facilities from the Dilthey Corporation. The facilities allow for dignitas to be earned from the colony’s inhabitants, making the station a tasty morsel for the Main Belt.
station.Epitome.name: Epitome Colony
station.Escher.desc: Deep below the surface of Ganymede an entire residential complex has been carved out— it is reminiscent of the very first moon bunkers. It is equipped with an impressive defensive perimeter. It often serves as a hideout for PMCs or small corporations that need a stronghold in the Outer System.
station.Escher.name: M. C. Escher
station.EStation.desc: E is a laboratory for the production of recreational and relaxation drugs. Here you will find a tablet or injection of every taste and color.
station.EStation.name: E
station.FeatheredTemple.desc: The Feathered Temple is a cluster of phased structures amidst the jungles. It seems that a large section of Venus's bramfatura has moved here. The place’s name derives from the prevailing bird theme in the design of its quasimorphic structures.
station.FeatheredTemple.name: Feathered Temple
station.February.desc: This is a prison built in the depths of Mechta. It is very conservative, without any frills. There are cages, long corridors and guards who tired and angry at the world.
station.February.name: February
station.FlatObsidian.desc: Secret laboratory belonging to the Fresco Corporation, where research on quasimorphosis was carried out. Dr. Eipschwitz assembled the Telephaturic Dislocator here—a device that allows access to planetary bramfatures. Flat Obsidian can currently be used as a convenient transit base on the surface of Mercury. If you are not afraid of the phased temple located beneath it.
station.FlatObsidian.name: Flat Obsidian
station.Flinthold.desc: A mining factory whose tunnels cut through a small mountain range that runs along Ceres's equator. It's hard to find a place in the Solar System more boring than Flinthold. That's except when corporations take direct action here, of course.
station.Flinthold.name: Flinthold
station.Fortuna.desc: Fortuna University is an engineering and physics university. Cutting-edge research is conducted here, but training courses are the main source of income. Graduates of Fortuna are almost guaranteed to secure employment and can choose whichever corporation they prefer.
station.Fortuna.name: Fortuna University
station.Forward.desc: A colony on the surface of 434 Hungaria that serves many different functions at once. It is a spaceport, a repair dock and a transshipment warehouse base, as well as a city for those who cannot find transport in the Outer or Inner System and are forced to look for work here. 434 Hungaria's unique position on the border between the Main Belt and the Inner System makes ownership of Forward extremely profitable.
station.Forward.name: Forward
